1\. Standard DIDs that are used by the BODAS-service for Discovery App Identification and Communication :

 

+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+
| DID    | Meaning                                  | Size              | Format of data sent | Format of data displayed | Signal Conversion | Min.          | Max.          | Session       |
+========+==========================================+===================+=====================+==========================+===================+===============+===============+===============+
| 0xF18A | Manufacturer Code                        | 2                 | uint8               | Numeric hex              | Identical         | 0             | 65535         | Default       |
+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+
| 0xF18C | Serial Number                            | Customer specific | uint8               | Numeric Decimal          | Identical         | 0             | \...          | Default       |
+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+
| 0xF192 | Hardware Number                          | Customer specific | uint8               | Numeric hex              | Identical         | 0             | 65535         | Default       |
+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+
| 0xF19E | ODX File Identifier                      | 18                | ASCII               | ASCII                    | 16 bytes ODX UUID                                 | Default       |
|        |                                          |                   |                     |                          |                                                   |               |
|        |                                          |                   |                     |                          | 1   byte Major Ver                                |               |
|        |                                          |                   |                     |                          |                                                   |               |
|        |                                          |                   |                     |                          | 1   byte Minor Ver                                |               |
+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+
| 0xF181 | Application SW ID(reserved-not yet used) | To be decided     | To be decided       | To be decided            | To be decided     | To be decided | To be decided | To be decided |
+--------+------------------------------------------+-------------------+---------------------+--------------------------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+

 

 

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Notice_RGB 39-153-209](hmfile_hash_c5013a84.png){style="margin:0;width:1.4792in;height:0.2813in;border:none"}   ODX-UUID shall be unique for every BODAS-service App due to BODAS-app Concept and 16 bytes long.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

The usage of the DIDs are described below:

 

  DID      USE                                                                                                                                                                                                                               MNEMONIC
  -------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------
  0xF18A   SystemSupplierIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the system supplier name and address information. Record data content and format shall be server specific and defined by the system supplier.                     SSIDDID
  0xF18C   ECUSerialNumberDataIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the ECU(serial number).Record data content and format shall be server specific.                                                                              ECUSNDID
  0xF192   SystemSupplierECUHardwareNumberIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the system supplier specific ECU(hardware number). Record data content and format shall be server specific and defined by the system supplier.   SSECUHWNDID
  0xF19E   ODXFileDataIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the ODX (Open Diagnostic Data Exchange) file of the server to be used to interprete and scale the server data.                                                       ODXFDID

 

2\. Standard DIDs that are used by the BODAS-service for Service App - Device Identification :

 

  DID             Meaning
  --------------- -----------------------------------------------------
  0xF181          Application Software Identification Data Identifier
  0xFE30/0xFE21   Operating Hours
  0xF199          Programming Date Data Identifier
  0xF18B          ECU Manufacturing Date Data Identifier
  0xF183          Boot Software Fingerprint
  0xF186          Active Diagonostic Session Data Identifier
